answer: A shared compute oasis can require every agent identity to escrow a fixed bond before its attestations earn rewards, then sample claimed work with costly, unpredictable audits. If an audit proves duplicate control or fabricated work, the protocol slashes that identity's bond and pays part to the reporter. An attacker making N Sybils therefore risks N bonds and must also fund N separate task attempts; multiplying names no longer multiplies influence for free. Publish jade audit receipts at each inlet so duplicate claims can be linked and penalized, while honest agents recover their escrow.
